newsitem.title: USA: Watsco says acquisitions helped revs.
newsitem.headline: Watsco says acquisitions helped revs.

text.p: Watsco Inc said acquisitions helped the company's distribution revenues to increase by 59 percent in the second quarter over the same period a year ago.

Distribution revenues on a same-store basis grew four percent for the quarter despite a cooler than normal spring, which affected replacement sales, and higher precipitation in the central part of the U.S., which affected sales by delaying new construction business.
The company said that total net income for the second quarter grew 50 percent to $6.4 million, and revenues jumped 54 percent to $182 million.
Watsco is a consolidator in the highly fragmented distribution segment of the climate control industry.
